title: From empowering teachers to shaping futures: Gabay Guro looks ahead to 20 years

blocks.text: For nearly two decades, Gabay Guro has invested in Filipino teachers through scholarships, professional development, classroom improvements, and digital learning initiatives, building a long-term education advocacy that has reached educators and learners across the Philippines. Established in 2007, the program has helped more than 50,000 teachers strengthen their professional skills through training initiatives, supported the graduation of 2,272 education scholars, and improved learning environments by donating 61 double-classrooms nationwide. These milestones come as Gabay Guro prepares for its Grand Gathering 2026 on November 29 at the Meralco Theater in Pasig City, an annual celebration recognizing the contributions of Filipino educators.
